about.label: about
about.title: Not a straight line.
about.description: My path here was anything but straight. I spent nine years as a public sector analyst, studied Accounting, then Systems Analysis and Development — and it was in development that I found what I actually wanted to do. In July 2024, I got my first “yes” as a developer. For a while I balanced both: analyst by day, dev by night. At 29, I left it all behind and made the full switch. Today I work as a frontend developer at Nuuvem, building interfaces with SvelteKit, TypeScript and Tailwind on

career.label: career
career.title: Where I've been, where I am.

startamus.body: Frontend developer at Startamus, a consultancy where I worked on projects for various clients. For an insurance sector client, I helped migrate the frontend of two legacy React class-based systems to Next.js. On another project, I worked on a financial system — building an internal tool from scratch and adding new features to an existing loan platform. I also contributed to the spawnd MVP at Nuuvem and helped build a hybrid app with React Native and Expo for a forum.

nuuvem.body: Frontend developer at Nuuvem, working on spawnd. I'm part of an incredible team, building new features and maintaining the product.
